Lena V: Hi all - opening my first PR to tweak the retry backoff in packages/client. CI lint flagged a few nit rules. For a new hire, should I fix lints in this PR or is it okay to leave trivial style nits for a follow-up?

Marco P: welcome! fix obvious lint errors here. If fixing them touches unrelated files, isolate those in a separate PR.

Lena V: cool. The linter complains about `no-console` in a small local debug log. Is `console.debug` acceptable behind a feature flag?

Ivy T: prefer removing console statements; use the logger util (`lib/logger`) so logs obey env flags. If it's truly transient, remove before merge.

Lena V: got it. Branch naming question: do we use `feat/` or `eng/` prefixes for client changes?

Marco P: for client-side infra use `feat/client/...` or `fix/client/...`. If it's platform-level, use `eng/...`. Include ticket id if present.

Review Bot: CI started for branch feat/client-retry-backoff (1935000000.0001).

Lena V: one last thing: do reviewers want me to squash before merge?

Ivy T: no need to squash pre-merge. We'll usually squash-and-merge. Keep commits meaningful while iterating.

Lena V: thanks everyone! I'll run `pnpm -w eslint --fix`, swap the console to logger, and push the PR.

Review Bot: Lint job failed: packages/client/src/retry.ts:12:3 - unexpected console. See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.example/1935000000/jobs/5

Lena V: pushed fix, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/client/pull/88. Reviewer: @Marco P
